primary_metric: Allowed-set agreement divided by all planned calls; incorrect and unresolved reported separately.
case_unit: Unique change; family clusters also reported. Repeats are correlated, not independent cases.
holdout_precondition: Independent human adjudication, then freeze all labels, inputs, category questions, policy, thresholds, metadata, baseline rules and scoring code before first call.
no_tuning: Sensitivity analyses are predeclared diagnostics; primary threshold stays 0.5. New choices require new protocol and fresh holdout.
paired_context: Development only. Same original historical revision, diff, questions, model version, thresholds and repeats; only context varies. No causal context claim without this paired execution. Not executed in this revision.
model_choice: Not evaluated. Stronger downstream reviewer/model selection requires a separately frozen protocol, ground-truth vulnerability scoring, paired comparison and explicit API budget before calls.
live_budget: Routing calls only, at most 42 per development workspace or 27 per holdout workspace; no retries. Provider USD ceiling is not enforced by this client; record API-reported cost. No downstream model comparisons authorized by this protocol.
